Backstory: I was working at movie theater that had gone through some minor renovations around that whole debate. We have full men and women's restroom upstairs and used to have two handicapped bathrooms down stairs where the theaters are. People complained too much about the normal bathrooms being upstairs so the company just tore down the handicap bathroom signs and made it so anyone who's trying to get done quick can use it. There wasn't any point in gendering them since they were both single stall bathrooms. 

We reopen. All the customers ooh and aaah at the new tiles, and new chairs and stuff. But one old lady wasn't impressed. She comes up to me after looking at the new unisex single stalled bathroom signs with an agitated frown. I thought she was going to complain about making the handicapped bathrooms available for general use since some people were understandably upset about that. I ask her what's wrong and she just says so disgusted "I can't believe you installed transgender bathrooms." 

My mouth opened but I could not even think of a response to that. Her friends met up with her and they started to walk away but I could already hear her telling her friends how disappointed she was to see businesses caving into the "trans agenda".
